name: Ducati Monster (air-cooled, 1993-2014)
engine: 583-1078 cc air-cooled 90-degree L-twin, carbs (early) or fuel injected, belt-driven desmo cams
intro: The original naked Ducati. Belt-driven desmo valves, a dry clutch on most, and carbs on early ones.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2009 Monster 696s are in recall 09V142 (wiring harness can touch the head and exhaust). Some 2011-2012 Monster 1100 EVOs are in recall 12V073 (rear rims). Some 2012 Monster 1100 EVO and 796 bikes are in recall 12V188 (rear brake pads).

add.title: Check the timing belts and desmo valve clearances
add.instructions: Replace the cam timing belts on schedule, by age as well as miles, and check the desmo opening and closing clearances. Old belts can snap and wreck the engine.
add.reason: Ducati belt-drive twins need belts changed on time even if the bike sat.

G: Early Monsters have carbs. Later ones are fuel injected. Skip the steps that don't match.
H: Monsters with Desmodue engines use belts. Change them by age even if the bike barely moved.

recalls.what: Main wiring harness may touch the vertical cylinder head and exhaust.
Rear rims marked DU6-RR may be faulty.

recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the rear pads free.
